entities.summary: Philip Treacy (b. 1967-05-26, Ahascragh) was a filmmaker or theatre director of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Ahascragh and Ireland. Known in the fields of ireland, architects & designers, europe.
